method: Name ranking from complete parse-only census; selected full name families inspected to expose contracts missed by body thresholds. Counts are literal clauses, not expanded default arities.

reviewed_families.name: parse_time
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name in frozen census read, including heads and fallback clauses.
reviewed_families.assessment: All six clauses in two modules read. ModelAvailability accepts DateTime, ISO strings and integer Unix seconds; ModelDiscovery accepts ISO strings only, otherwise nil. The common ISO clause is real, but substituting full functions would change accepted inputs. Keep scalar conversion reuse separate from provider/model input normalization.

reviewed_families.name: parse_datetime
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name in frozen census read, including heads and fallback clauses.
reviewed_families.assessment: All eight clauses in four modules read. DecisionQuery.Cursor requires DateTime.from_iso8601 offset exactly zero and returns ok/error invalid. Comment poller returns DateTime/nil for binary input; GitHub Issues and Linear explicitly accept nil but their general clause is unguarded. Preserve cursor UTC restriction, return shapes and type guards; do not use a permissive nil-returning parser for persisted cursor validation.

reviewed_families.name: to_iso8601
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name in frozen census read, including heads and fallback clauses.
reviewed_families.assessment: All four clauses in two reset-time modules read. Both nil clauses return nil; both other clauses shift zone to Etc/UTC then render ISO. These fall below the five-line body threshold yet are true same-operation candidates. Reuse only a provider-neutral time formatting primitive if one already fits; do not unify provider reset parsing, which has distinct input policies.

reviewed_families.name: format
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name in frozen census read, including heads and fallback clauses.
reviewed_families.assessment: All twelve clauses in seven modules read. Operations include CI diagnostic prose, slot-warmth table, supervision-health delegation/formatting, CLI format-option validation, timezone-aware minute rendering and pricing boundary ISO. Sharing this name supplies no common abstraction. Preserve the existing SupervisionHealth formatter delegation rather than count it as duplicate work.

reviewed_families.name: timestamp
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name in frozen census read, including heads and fallback clauses.
reviewed_families.assessment: All 36 clauses in nineteen modules read. Family includes parsing with plain or field-tagged errors, map-field extraction plus Diagnostic, ISO serialization, string passthrough, receive/current-time fallback, no-argument clock sampling, and HEEx components with ISO/relative/timezone presentations. Do not create one timestamp function for these meanings. Matching Decision public projection ISO/nil clauses are a local codec reuse candidate; preserve DecisionHistory string passthrough, DecisionProjection narrow nil/DateTime contract, and unavailable versus utc_now fallback. UI formatting precision and timezone are surface policy.

reviewed_families.name: safe_call
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name in frozen census read, including heads and fallback clauses.
reviewed_families.assessment: All eleven definitions in eleven modules read. TUI and IssueContext collapse all failures to nil; telemetry accepts a caller fallback and catches all; Streamdeck Live/Projection catch exceptions and exits only; AddAgentSubmission preserves tagged exception/throw reasons; Presenter wraps success in ok and failures in error; ProcessReaper discards normal RPC result and returns ok even on exit; ProviderAccountGeneration catches RPC exits only. Reuse existing TUI RenderState.safe_call locally, but do not infer a universal safety helper. Preserve arity, success envelope, throws, exception detail and timeout behavior.

reviewed_families.name: normalize
reviewed_families.coverage: All 81 literal definitions/declarations named normalize read in full, including heads and fallback clauses. Additional full files read: ToolCallIdentity, JSONSafe and UnitsRow.URL; relevant Bounded URL pipeline and URI rules also inspected. This is function-family review, not full review of all transitive helpers.
reviewed_families.assessment: The name spans fingerprint canonicalization, diagnostic clipping, provider telemetry conversion, command validation, hook/webhook projections, cache inspection, JSON serialization, conversation trust filtering, opaque identifiers, pause persistence, meter schema, UI fallback and URL validation. Preserve domain contracts; spelling alone supplies no shared abstraction.
constraints: ToolCallIdentity recursively stringifies atom map keys and converts tuples to lists while retaining scalar atoms/unknown values. JSONSafe additionally handles DateTime/structs and converts non-JSON scalars. Fingerprint uses deterministic term_to_binary after normalization; replacing it with JSONSafe changes identity input semantics and requires compatibility analysis.

Decision answer/delegation/enrichment/revision/validation own different lifecycle commands, authority, optimistic version/sequence checks and record-specific errors. Share validation primitives without erasing command policy.
LiveConversation drops tool/system/untrusted-user shapes; HookEvents retains raw map with classification. Neither is a generic trusted-event sanitizer.

Provider meter normalization validates snapshot/patch/tombstone schema with account-generation metadata; headless usage dispatches through provider adapters into envelopes/coverages. Do not conflate measurement semantics.
OpaqueIdentifier validates bounded allowed characters and unchanged redaction, unlike credential trim-to-nil or diagnostic clipping.

UnitsRow.URL accepts http/https default ports, empty/no query, matches issue identity and strips fragments. BuildOrder.Bounded.github_issue_url_for uses bounded HTTPS-only nil-query/nil-fragment GitHub validation. Sharing requires an explicit URL policy decision.
Cache inspector preserves false/zero/empty-list body presence and distinguishes data_source from processing source; truthiness-based generic normalization would lose that meaning.
Invalid TicketObservation input produces an unknown observation; meter input rejects schema; webhook returns error/drop; UI emits domain fallbacks. Preserve these different failure meanings.
Webhook ModeRegistry and ModeTable share trim/lowercase repo string clauses below the body threshold; ModeTable also has a nonbinary fallback. Whole-function substitution must preserve input policy.

reviewed_families.name: atomic_write
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name read from the frozen snapshot.
reviewed_families.assessment: All six literal definitions in six modules read. Four domain wrappers already delegate to Fs.atomic_write; Fs is the shared primitive, not a sixth redundant implementation. ToolResultSpill adds random names, exclusive staging-file creation, permission/sync, destination absence and workspace containment checks with final cleanup. Replacing it directly with Fs would drop preconditions and change the return from {:ok,path} to :ok.
constraints: PackStatus creates directories and logs failures; membership FileOps rejects nonregular/symlink destinations; Checkpoint maps errors to checkpoint_write_failed; RetiredFloor is a thin option wrapper.
Fs uses a unique-integer temporary suffix and optional fsync/mode. Its generic writer is not the spill policy boundary.
Read Fs and membership FileOps fully, plus spill write/sync/destination helpers. This is no durability certification or filesystem-race test; no saving measured.

reviewed_families.name: control_api_call
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses for this exact name read from the frozen snapshot.
reviewed_families.assessment: All six definitions in six orchestrator modules read. Interrupts, PriorityControl and Slots share the same fixed5000ms wrapper; OperatorMessages and RemoteControlMode accept timeout parameters. PauseResume instead reads a configured timeout and distinguishes timeout, noproc/nodedown and other call failures.
constraints: Extracting a common transport wrapper can preserve explicit timeout and error-mapping policy. Do not replace PauseResume with the generic catch-all unavailable mapping.
The same availability precheck does not eliminate a process-exit race; existing catches are necessary.

These families overlap body-census candidates, so do not count the identical wrappers as new savings or independent duplicate opportunities. Caller-wide runtime behavior is not established by this family read.

reviewed_families.name: age_label
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal clauses for this exact name read from the frozen census/source.
reviewed_families.assessment: Read all21clauses in six modules. Inputs include seconds, milliseconds and age_ms maps; outputs vary from raw milliseconds to rounded units, mixed minute/second precision and pluralized days. Missing input returns explicit unknown strings except ProviderMetersPresenter, where it returns nil. Analytics also has a source-freshness threshold before showing elapsed time.
constraints: Do not substitute helpers by name: converting milliseconds twice or losing a missing value changes meaning.
Display precision and text are surface policy. Share unit conversion only with explicit input units and preserve unavailable versus zero.
No whole-surface rendering audit or live user-visible age assertion performed.

reviewed_families.name: freshness_label
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal clauses for this exact name read from the frozen census/source.
reviewed_families.assessment: Read all25clauses in six modules. RunSummary, CurrentRunOutcomes, UsageSummary and ProviderMeters map stale to Healthy; ConversationDrawer uses current and Stale; GitHubCache maps stale to older and stringifies other values. UsageSummary adds empty; ProviderMeters has no unavailable-specific label.
constraints: These four stale mappings corroborate only a subset of existing web-occ-09; do not create a duplicate finding or certify its complete nine-site claim.
A shared presenter policy could eliminate copy drift, but choosing a label is an explicit behavior decision. Preserve empty, partial, unavailable and unknown distinctions.
Read call sites retaining status alongside label in ProviderMeters and CurrentRunOutcomes; label collapse does not prove the underlying status atom was lost.

reviewed_families.name: count_label
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal clauses for this exact name read from the frozen census/source.
reviewed_families.assessment: Read all18clauses in six modules. Families include integer-or-dash, noun pluralization, loaded-versus-total, partial counts with plus suffix, and ticket availability/truncation/search match summaries. GitHubCache special-cases misses; DecisionLatency's pluralizer does not.
constraints: Do not replace partial count N+ or truncated at-least-N with an exact integer.
Preserve unsupported tracker separately from unavailable and search matches separately from total.
These are selected function contracts, not a claim of current malformed-input or rendering failures.

reviewed_families.name: start_link
reviewed_families.coverage: All122literal definitions read in two bounded source batches;438summed source-span lines. This is not complete module or callback review.
reviewed_families.assessment: Most definitions delegate to GenServer startup, but the family also includes Agent, Supervisor, DynamicSupervisor, Phoenix.PubSub and domain facade delegates. Repeated conventional startup syntax is not evidence that the domain processes should share an implementation or package.
constraints: Preserve registration policy: fixed module names, caller-overridable defaults, unregistered startup, derived via/slot names and facade-owned names are not interchangeable.

Some wrappers pop :name before passing init options; others pass it through. Financial caches construct map state while most owners pass opts. Do not unify by textual shape without init-contract review.

DecisionStore validates start options before launching; PubSubBoot waits for old names to release; HTTPServer installs a URL callback and can return :ignore; LiveConversation derives restart-announcement policy from the name.
Existing facade delegates already express ownership; do not count them as duplicate implementations. The two-line OTP call is often the simplest appropriate boundary.
No framework nil-name behavior, runtime startup failure, process-count saving or transitive boot correctness asserted. Exact-body overlap is non-additive.

reviewed_families.name: terminate
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal clauses read from the frozen source, including fallbacks and delegates; no transitive whole-module coverage implied.
reviewed_families.assessment: All42literal clauses in36modules read. The family includes OTP callbacks plus explicit task/LiveView lifecycle helpers. Shared callback spelling does not establish shared resource ownership or safe cleanup order.
constraints: Keep owned versus injected writer distinction in DecisionMetrics; graceful flush/checkpoint paths do not prove crash durability or execution after kill.
Orchestrator cleanup uses drain:false to avoid latching the application reaper during supervised restart; do not replace it with application shutdown semantics.
Claude telemetry explicitly unlinks/stops/monitors its listener; opencode closes the port before reaping descendants; financial cache clears pending tasks before stopping its owned supervisor.
UI cleanup includes terminal restoration, relay/voice shutdown and voice-lease release. A no-op fallback is not a missing cleanup finding without proving acquired ownership.
Function spans only: transitive helper behavior, exception safety and shutdown timeout sufficiency are not certified.

reviewed_families.name: subscribe
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal clauses read from the frozen source, including fallbacks and delegates; no transitive whole-module coverage implied.
reviewed_families.assessment: All45literal clauses in38modules read. Thin Phoenix.PubSub wrappers coexist with Exchange pattern validation, durable Executor subscription-state updates, generation-scoped provider streams, authenticated FinancialData subscriptions, explicit-pid ledger subscriptions and monitored workspace ownership waiters.
constraints: Preserve caller-self versus explicit recipient semantics. WorkflowStore's signature accepts a pid but its body subscribes the calling process; do not treat it as equivalent to UsageLedger's explicit-pid registration without caller review.
Ticket detail/history subscribe to identity and reset topics; LiveConversation canonicalizes source and subscribes with restart handling; these are richer than one topic subscribe.
Provider account/meter subscriptions resolve current generation before binding. FinancialData authorizes context and obtains subscription identity before replacement.
Some optional observability wrappers catch failures and return ok; account/financial routes return unavailable/authentication errors. A generic catch-and-ignore wrapper would change the contract.
Common one-line PubSub calls are already calls to the shared transport. Do not count wrappers as duplicated transport implementation or claim savings from deleting them.

reviewed_families.name: health
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses read from frozen census/source; supporting helper and caller graphs not fully reviewed.
reviewed_families.assessment: All44clauses in27modules read. The family spans direct GenServer/backend getters, projection field access, HTTP health probing, listener-binding coverage, snapshot availability and reason-bearing UI projections. Common spelling does not supply one health enum or result shape.
constraints: CurrentRunProjection.Value maps available/writable to healthy and stale/partial/unknown to degraded, while OutcomeSnapshot.SourceState maps partial/stale to partial and has a healthy fallback. Preserve each input domain before proposing a common mapper.

RunSummary.Status combines invalid-run, source health, freshness, weight and truncation reasons; WeightFacts applies availability before stale/race policy. These are aggregate policies rather than interchangeable scalar helpers.
ProviderMetersPresenter preserves state, failure, timestamps, failure count and age alongside labels. Do not replace that projection with a single status string.

Facade delegation already supplies reuse. DeliveryLog calls its wrapper with writable as fallback, while PackStatus catches exits as unavailable; caller/wrapper review is required before declaring either contract correct or equivalent.
Overlap with web-occ-20 is partial corroboration of vocabulary differences, not a new independent defect.

reviewed_families.name: freshness
reviewed_families.coverage: All literal definition clauses read from frozen census/source; supporting helper and caller graphs not fully reviewed.
reviewed_families.assessment: All28clauses in19modules read. The family includes delegation, source maps, reconciliation metadata, scalar normalization, age thresholds, expiry deadlines and UI status/label projection.
constraints: TicketHistory and TicketActivity use age > threshold; cache entries use age >= stale/expired thresholds. Equality is observable and must not change accidentally during consolidation.
Provider meter reconciler treats no expires_at as fresh and expiry equal to now as stale; this is not equivalent to an observation timestamp being absent, which other domains represent as unknown.
Membership runtime returns reconciliation status plus last-observed/recovered/reconciled metadata and pending terminal verification, not a generic elapsed-age result.
RunSummary freshness aggregates normalized per-source states; UnitsRow preserves per-source freshness with unknown fallbacks. Shared types can document contracts without collapsing policies.
No runtime stale-data incident, input reachability proof or savings claimed from this function-family read.

limits: Seventeen selected families and515literal definitions/declarations reviewed. Remaining names and other high-frequency callbacks are not claimed reviewed. Name/body equality is not semantic duplication; overlap with body/raw reviews is non-additive. Transitive correctness and savings are not claimed.
